prompt:
Create a NEW original full-body game character based on the supplied REAL PERSON photographs, drawn in the deliberately goofy, chunky, distorted 1993 Day of the Tentacle adventure-game style. Reference 1 is the FACE likeness authority; reference 2 is his real BODY and left tattoo sleeve; reference 3 is his CHEST TATTOO; reference 4 is the APPROVED GAME ROOM and the visual-style authority. Output ONLY the isolated fully-clothed character on REAL transparent alpha, no room, no photo background, no text. This must LOOK LIKE THE MAN in reference1, not the generic muscular spiky-haired cartoon hero from previous attempts. Preserve identifying face geometry: notably HIGH BROAD FOREHEAD and receding temples, short brown hair swept casually from his own left to right with short sides and just a modest wave on top, long oval face, broad heavy rectangular-rounded Persol-like glasses (change the photographed black acetate to BROWN TORTOISESHELL as the owner now wears), light grey-green eyes with relaxed lids, straight relatively narrow nose bridge ending in a modest rounded slightly rosy nose (not a giant hooked or ski-jump nose), dark brown moustache joining a full medium-long dark brown beard with a rounded tapered bottom, subtly lighter brown centre, just a FEW grey strands as the owner specified. A calm wry half-smile and thoughtful slightly raised brow, not a big mascot grin. Make him recognisably a white man aged48, mature but not elderly. Use the actual full-body reference for a SLIM NORMAL FIT build, natural narrow shoulders, relaxed belly and thin-to-normal forearms: absolutely NO bodybuilder chest, huge biceps, V-shaped superhero torso, or overly broad shoulders.

CRITICAL STYLE: the old character was too anatomically naturalistic and too finely shaded to fit the fourth reference room. Push this one decisively into chunky early-1990s cartoon adventure proportions: oversized expressive HEAD including beard roughly 38-40% of entire figure height, SHORT compact torso and legs, generous hands and oversized simple trainers, slightly wonky asymmetric stance. Draw thick DARK PLUM hand-inked outer contours, broad simple flat CEL-COLOUR shapes, only one bold shadow tone per colour, very few facial lines, three or four hair shapes rather than detailed individual strands. It should look drawn by the SAME HAND as the approved crooked purple room. No modern polished mascot illustration, no fine hatching, no realistic anatomy, no 3D, no airbrushing, no pixel dithering.

Wardrobe is the pale SAGE GREEN short-sleeved V-neck T-shirt from the body photo, muted blue-grey trousers, oversized off-white casual trainers. This is a full-body relaxed THREE-QUARTER RIGHT-FACING idle pose, head and toes point right while the chest faces partly toward the viewer. Show the actual anatomical LEFT-arm full Japanese sleeve, on the VIEWER'S RIGHT in this mostly front-facing stance. Use the supplied tattoo photos as shape/colour reference: flowing teal/blue-grey waves and cloud shapes, sperm whale upper arm, squid and anchor forearm, muted ink/teal/rust accents. Simplify to large cartoon tattoo motifs that read at game scale. The anatomical RIGHT arm remains UNTATTOOED. Only a SMALL TIGER FORELEG / PAW and grey-blue Japanese clouds peek over the shirt's V-neck; NO tiger head or face above the collar and most of the chest design stays under the shirt. Keep the owner fully clothed. Whole figure from hair to soles visible, centered with modest even margins. Preserve native transparency, opaque flat colours inside the figure, fully transparent outside silhouette. No floor shadow, halo, background haze, panel or watermark. Make a playful believable game adventurer who resembles these photos.
